\section{Method}

The stage duration of worker $h$ is given by Eq.~\eqref{eq:dur}.
\begin{equation}\label{eq:dur}
d = \bar{d}\,(1 + \kappa f)
\end{equation}
The coefficient is $\kappa = 0.12$ for all 9 workers. A stage starts only if the bound holds, that is,
\begin{equation}\label{eq:safe}
f + \alpha d \le F,
\end{equation}
where $F = 0.75$ is the limit of the 3 workers in Table~\ref{tab:x}.

The return of an episode with 40 decisions telescopes as
\begin{align*}
R &= a + b && \text{(sum of the two terms)}
\end{align*}
and equals 3 for the schedule in Table~\ref{tab:y}.
